acceptance_criteria.criterion: Multiple complete mixed-element reports are coherent and materially meet principal-quality bar.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Six normal UI-authored populated desktop reports are retained; responsive clipping and export meaning are tracked separately.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Six genres/holdouts show task-grounded whole-report character and hierarchy, not one mechanically repeated template family.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Per-report Visual Director reviews A–F document distinct executive, spatial RCA, experiment, operating handoff, monthly operations and sparse safety information structures in a shared product language.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Sophisticated results are produced through normal supported authoring, not hidden source manipulation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Six normal UI journeys, fresh Blank E/F, edits and exports are retained; no source or fixture changes. Direct pointer drag/resize and bitmap/image annotation were not recorded and are not inferred.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Reuse/remix provides obvious practical leverage without semantic/source leakage.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Measured reuse-vs-blank journeys, destination values in PPTX, unchanged source, shared-slot and explicit manual re-entry receipts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Version/history/save/reload/conflict recovery remain governed and usable.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Native report lifecycle integrity receipt plus undo/redo/reload/history/conflict and source revision receipts; raw gates/tests included.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 390/320 reading is free of material clipping, destructive wrapping, unreadable diagrams, hidden table data without affordance or heading/content collision.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: R3-RESP-01 fails on fresh F 390 scene: clipped rationale, hidden metric delta/target and two hidden table rows without vertical cue. B/D 320 diagrams remain legible; no heading/content collision observed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Actual supported PPTX rendering preserves visible report meaning and hierarchy, not only structure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: R3-EXPORT-01: source distribution/group charts become line series and numeric trend values flatten in Quick Look previews. Chart package structure itself records loss. Qualified headless Office render was unavailable and disclosed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Wrong-type/missing/ambiguous remap states are truthful, actionable and fail closed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Fresh native wrong-type/ambiguous journeys and CHG-208 acceptance; source JUnit distinguishes missing-name/selected-unavailable. Destination identity, expected/observed type-role, Apply gating and unchanged report/source/preset are retained.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No new material P0/P1 or world-class composition/reuse failure class is found.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Two confirmed P1 findings R3-RESP-01 and R3-EXPORT-01.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Evidence is complete enough for independent whole-report inspection.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Six full desktop/390 canvases, B/D 320, PDFs/contact sheets, editable PPTX/SVG, preview rasters and chart semantics, raw release/JUnit/logs, authoring/reuse/remap/lifecycle receipts, immutable manifest and bundle. Office-engine raster is unavailable and explicitly disclosed.
